name: Lily
subtitle: A native YouTube Music client for iPhone.
description: Lily is a YouTube Music client written in Swift and SwiftUI, with no web wrapper. Premium audio at 256 kbps, Automix, moving covers, word-by-word lyrics, downloads for offline play, and a look that takes on each song's artwork.

apps.name: Lily
apps.subtitle: A native YouTube Music client.
apps.localizedDescription:
Lily is a YouTube Music client for iPhone, native from top to bottom: Swift and SwiftUI on Apple's own audio engine, with no web wrapper.

Now Playing
• Where an album has a moving cover, it plays full screen in Now Playing, as in Apple Music, and on the lock screen; sign in to Spotify and songs show their Canvas
• Lyrics that light up word by word as they're sung, with translations and romanisations where the lyrics have them; tap a line to jump to it
• Like and dislike, a queue you drag into order, AirPlay, and a sleep timer that stops after a set time or at the end of the song

Sound
• 256 kbps Opus with Premium
• Automix blends each song into the next as a DJ would, on the beat when the tempos match. Without it, songs follow on gaplessly, or with a crossfade of your chosen length
• Volume levelling, a ten-band equaliser with presets, wide stereo, and crossfeed, mono and balance for headphones
• Playback speed from 0.8x to 1.3x, the pitch moving with it as on a record, and a pause when headphones are unplugged

Your music
• Downloads for songs, albums and playlists, and smart downloads that keep the songs you play and more like them, picked afresh each day
• Pin songs, albums, playlists and artists to the top of Library, and order saved albums by artist
• Save albums and playlists, subscribe to artists, and rename, reorder, share or delete your own playlists
• Block an artist to keep their songs out of what plays and what smart downloads picks, unless you choose one
• Speed dial on Home, Explore, radio, autoplay, history, and search with recent searches you swipe away
• Shuffle that spreads out artists and albums, and Smart Shuffle that mixes in songs like them
• Share or copy a link from any song or card's menu

Looks
• Black, Dark or Light, or System to follow the phone, in nine accents: Lily's orchid, seven more, and one taken from the artwork
• Pages sit on their artwork frosted like glass, with Liquid Glass in the tab bar, mini player and icon
• On iPhone Duo, Now Playing sits beside its lyrics or queue, and albums and playlists beside their tracks (iOS 27.1 or later). Stand it half open and the artwork faces you, with the controls on the flat half, and fold to scrub, if you turn it on, turns the hinge into a seek

Also
• It reopens on the song you left, at the second you left it
• The lock screen, Control Center, AirPods, and scrobbling to Last.fm and ListenBrainz
• An HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy of your own
• A choice to keep what you play out of your YouTube history
• Settings shows Lily's version, and when a newer one is out, offers to install it with SideStore, AltStore or Feather

Works signed out; sign in with Google for your own library and feed.

Lily is unofficial. It uses YouTube's undocumented API, which is against YouTube's terms of service. Not affiliated with YouTube or Google.
